title: MoE Systems Architecture (DeepEP Normal/IBGDA, DualPipe/Dual-Batch Overlap & EPLB Load Balancing) Benchmark

workload_assumptions.model: DeepSeek-V3/R1 671B MoE (256 Routed Experts, Top-8 Active)

tiers.name: Tier 1: Generic NCCL All-to-All (CPU Proxy, Serial Comm-Compute & Static Unbalanced Expert Placement)
tiers.verdict: Anti-Pattern: 54.8% of wall-clock time spent waiting on blocking All-to-All & hot-expert stragglers

tiers.name: Tier 2: DeepEP High-Throughput & IBGDA Low-Latency Kernels (Serial Execution Without Ping-Pong Overlap)
tiers.verdict: Cuts raw All-to-All latency 4.2x via IBGDA, but serial dispatch/combine still leaves SMs idle 24.6% of step

tiers.name: Tier 3: DeepEP + Two-Batch Ping-Pong Overlap (Hides Comm Behind Compute, Static Expert Placement)
tiers.verdict: Hides 88% of RDMA transfer time, but domain-shift traffic spikes overload single-GPU hot experts (2.95x skew)

tiers.name: Tier 4: DeepEP (Normal + IBGDA) + DualPipe/Two-Batch Overlap + Hierarchical EPLB Redundant Hot Experts
tiers.verdict: Recommended: 1.8% exposed comm stall, 168us IBGDA latency, 1.09x load balance & $0.25/1M (-78.8%)
